hyperedges.label: Client-only dynamic route shells
hyperedges.note: All four feature routes are 'use client' shells that dynamic-import a Screen component with ssr:false.

hyperedges.label: Career mentorship data model
hyperedges.note: Together model the executive mentorship domain: archetypes, branched roadmaps, milestones, talent diagnostics, and 30-day briefs.

hyperedges.label: Global app shell composition
hyperedges.note: RootLayout binds three Google fonts as CSS variables onto the html element.

hyperedges.description: Sequential first-year career discovery flow: diagnostic -> archetype map -> deep dive -> talent stack -> 30-day brief, orchestrated by FirstYearScreen with persisted state.
Marketing landing page sections forming the investor-facing narrative arc: hero pitch -> metrics -> features -> testimonial -> closing CTA, with persistent investor ticker.
